title: Using tactical AI companion dialogue to help players defeat a boss without killing her living shield (V.E.T.O.R — A Ruptura, P016)
author: Sufficient-Cause2216
selftext:
Sharing a new 2m29s encounter trailer from our Windows indie project V.E.T.O.R — A Ruptura (\~80% in development, playable demo in preparation — no public playable demo yet), built on a custom HTML5 Canvas + synchronized video engine.

In the Limbo Spider encounter, defeating the boss is only half the fight: the spider carries a living man trapped inside a web cocoon and uses him as a human shield. Attacking carelessly can kill the captive you are trying to rescue.

How AI fits into both the gameplay loop and our production pipeline:
- Companion tactics & encounter dialogue: V.E.T.O.R (your robot companion) and real-time tactical dialogue help explain the hostage dilemma and guide player positioning toward safe openings rather than blind button-mashing.
- Audio & UI in this capture: Spoken dialogue is in English while the in-game UI shown is in Portuguese; combat traversal runs sped up (4x) with key tactical dialogue excerpts at normal speed (1x) over original battle music.
- Production tooling disclosure: Codex assists programming and visual support workflows, alongside Veo in specific pre-rendered video clips and localized voice acting.

Official gameplay video (2m29s): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vtvE\_7ay2\_4
Project page: https://vetorlogico.com/#conheca-o-jogo
itch.io devlog: https://jonie-magno-rangel.itch.io/vetor

Curious what fellow devs think about using live AI companion dialogue to steer player restraint rather than locking boss tactics into static popups.
